CRITIQUE APPLIED (literature-grounding-worker): D-01_ff agrees -- published PS MD uses PCFF/COMPASS-family Class II fields and reproduces bulk density within a few percent, so the class default stands and the NOT MEASURED parameter_coverage gap is accepted as build-time-verifiable. D-02_charges and D-03_electrostatics agree. No override applied.

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PSTR.ff_note: PCFF (Class II) via EMC. TraPPE-UA was rejected: its united-atom representation ignores the phenyl ring partial charges and pi-dihedral barriers that govern PS's Tg (~373K), and no TraPPE-UA PS Tg validation exists. PCFF explicitly parameterizes aromatic C-H charges and cross-terms; Soldera2006 (COMPASS/OPLS) confirms MD reaches PS Tg ~449-484K raw, WLF-corrected ~373K -- no direct PCFF PS Tg paper exists, so confidence is medium. DENSITY CAVEAT: PCFF underpredicts PS 300K density by -5.85% to -6.32% across three independent runs; PCFF's founding paper documents the same aromatic-ring deficit for benzene/toluene (-6.3%/-6.5%), which COMPASS reduces to -1.1%/-1.2% for the same compounds -- field_override='compass' is EMC-admissible but not build-tested against PS's SMILES. Do not generalize this aromatic-ring finding to non-aromatic classes.
Tg values for 12 polymers; PE Tg=281±52 K; PDMS Tg ~228 K. Validation data for PHYC and PSIL classes.
evidence.citation: Srivastava, A. et al. On-the-Fly Machine-Learned Force Fields for High-Fidelity Polymer Glass Transition Simulations. arXiv:2601.17137.

evidence.claim: AA-MD glass-transition/dynamics study of polycarbonate (PC) and PMMA via cooling simulations (Tg, radius of gyration, dihedral transitions, end effects, INM). IMPORTANT: PC uses the Kremer et al. force field and PMMA uses OPLS-AA — NEITHER is PCFF. It validates that AA-MD reproduces PC/PMMA Tg & Rg; it does NOT validate PCFF and does NOT benchmark mass density. Do not cite as a PCFF or density source. The 'PCFF PMMA density within 2%' result is NkepsuMbitou2025 (10.1016/j.commatsci.2025.113861, Fig 4 / §5.1).
evidence.citation: Tang, Z.; Okazaki, S. All-Atomistic Molecular Dynamics Study of the Glass Transition of Amorphous Polymers. Polymer 2022, 254, 125044.

evidence.claim: COMPASS+AMBER/OPLS MD Tg for PE, PMMA, PMA, PS, PMS; WLF analysis shows linear sim-exp correlation. PS Tg WLF-corrected ~373 K (matches experiment). Closest 'any MD Tg' evidence for PSTR; FF is COMPASS/OPLS, not PCFF.
evidence.citation: Soldera, A.; Metatla, N. Glass Transition of Polymers: Atomistic Simulation versus Experiments. Phys. Rev. E 2006, 74, 061803.

evidence.claim: Systematic review of Class I (GAFF2, OPLS-AA) and Class II (PCFF, CVFF) all-atom FFs for PMMA (PACR) and PIB/polyisobutylene (PHYC); benchmarks thermomechanical properties against experiment. Class II FFs outperform Class I for thermomechanical predictions; informs PACR and PHYC FF confidence notes.
evidence.citation: Nkepsu Mbitou, R. L.; Bedoui, F. A Review on All-Atom Force Fields Capabilities to Predict Polymer Properties: Case of Poly(methyl methacrylate) and Polyisobutylene Polymer Systems. Comput. Mater. Sci. 2025, 253, 113861.

evidence.claim: All-atom MD benchmark for Tg and density of PLA, PEG, and PVP; quantifies equilibration protocol errors and polydispersity effects. Density identified as the most reliable Tg observable regardless of protocol. Informs PEST (PLA) and POXI (PEG) simulation setup. NOTE: paper covers PLA/PEG/PVP — not PC/PA/PEEK as previously annotated.
evidence.citation: Klajmon, M. et al. Glass Transition and Structure of Organic Polymers from All-Atom Molecular Simulations. Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 2023, 62, 21437–21448.

evidence.claim: Repeat-unit element census from the SMILES: {'C': 8}; heteroatoms present: none. polymer_rules.json:electrostatics_decision_guide places PSTR in use_pppm.
charge_method='bond-increment': zero at plan time -- EMC applies the field's INCREMENT table during the build. preferred_builder=emc.
'bond-increment' is force-field-embedded: bond-increment is the Class II (PCFF/COMPASS) native scheme; the field's valence and nonbond terms were fit alongside it (preferred_ff='pcff').

alternatives: embedded (not adopted): zero at plan time -- charges are the force field's own atom-type parameters; no separate QM or empirical charge step runs
opls-library (not adopted): zero at plan time -- charges come from the OPLS library by atom type
none (not adopted): zero -- united-atom sites carry no partial charge
gasteiger (not adopted): negligible -- empirical electronegativity equalization, no QM
RESP (not adopted): per-chemistry QM (HF/6-31G*) before any MD can start -- the dominant pre-simulation cost for a novel repeat unit

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:electrostatics_decision_guide places PSTR in use_pppm.classes. Guide criterion: "Any heteroatom in backbone or major side group, or any functionality with |q| > 0.1 e on backbone atoms." Repeat-unit element census: {'C': 8}; heteroatoms: none.
evidence.citation: Afzal, M. A. F. et al. High-Throughput Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Validation of Thermophysical Properties of Polymers for Various Applications. ACS Appl. Polym. Mater. 2021, 3, 2, 620–630.

evidence.claim: NOT ASSESSABLE PRE-BUILD. The guide's |q| > 0.1 e threshold is on assigned partial charges, which do not exist until the build runs charge_method='bond-increment'. The heteroatom leg of the same criteria clause is satisfied independently, so the 'pppm' choice does not rest on this. No value is asserted.

Guide rationale: "Dipole-dipole interactions from C=O, C-F, C-N, Si-O, S=O groups affect bulk density and Tg by 5-20% if neglected (Afzal2021; Webb2024). PPPM with 12 Å real-space cutoff and 1e-6 accuracy is standard." Rejected alternative lj_cut: "Backbone partial charges < 0.1 e; long-range Coulomb contribution negligible. lj_cut is 2-3x faster and produces equivalent density/Tg (Afzal2021)." Priced at this run's cell: 7840 atoms, pcff family.
evidence.citation: Webb, M. A. et al. How to Determine Glass Transition Temperature of Polymer Electrolytes from Molecular Dynamics Simulations. J. Phys. Chem. B 2024, 128, 49, 11978–11991.

alternatives: lj_cut (rejected): guide criterion is "All backbone atoms are C or H only, with no heteroatoms (O, N, S, F, Cl, P, Si) in the backbone or in significant side groups." and lists only PHYC, PDIE. PSTR does not qualify.

assumptions: entanglement MW Me=16600 g/mol for member 'PS' (Mark 2007 Ch.25) / repeat-unit MW 104.2 g/mol -> DP@Me=159 -- reported for context only, not an acceptance criterion for bulk_modulus: entanglement Me governs shear/viscoelastic properties (plateau modulus, reptation), not the isothermal bulk modulus, which is an EOS/local-packing quantity. Establish chain-length convergence of density/K instead (a small DP sweep confirming both plateau) rather than requiring DP>=DP@Me.

nchain=10 is below the advisory PCFF production minimum 20. Its source ("Bejagam 2020") has no copy in this repo and no verified DOI, so the claim is unchecked; nchain>=10 (Wang 2021, verified) IS met, and Hayashi 2022 (RadonPy) ran nchain=10 across 1,077 polymers. Raising nchain to 20 at a fixed system-mass floor would halve per-chain MW (worse chain-length bias); raising it at fixed DP doubles cost for no criterion this module can state. Reported, not applied -- the L>=2*Rg finite-size gate (a separate, already-mechanized check) is the binding constraint on nchain; supply a nchain is now a pure function of the system-mass floor.
overrides is deliberately empty: materialize_plan() only auto-fills dp_typical/nchain for keys overrides does not set, so writing the derived cell here would suppress the solve it came from.
